calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, f.channel_code, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids,
  sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat,
  min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22')
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM l WHERE store_id<900 AND category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM l WHERE store_id<900 AND category<>'ZZ Test') AS my_net_gross_of_returns,
 (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id<900) AS rpt_before_returns,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM l WHERE store_id=999 OR category='ZZ Test') AS excluded_net,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id=900) AS web_lines_in_range,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id<900 AND channel_code<>'ST') AS nonST,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id<900 AND staff_purchase_flag) AS staff_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM l WHERE store_id<900 AND quantity<=0) AS nonpos_qty,
 (SELECT min(etl_loaded_at)||' / '||max(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) AS etl

calls.statement:
SELECT r.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net) refund_vat
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(f.vat_rate*100, 1) AS vat_rate_percent,
       SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
  AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate ORDER BY f.vat_rate
